challenge.title: New generation farmers can drive change. But they cannot do it alone.
challenge.paragraph1: Agrifood systems are shaped by structural barriers — or lock-ins — that can keep them on unsustainable paths and make change difficult. For new generation farmers, especially the young, these lock-ins include limited access to land and resources, gaps in knowledge, weak connections across the system, and limited participation in decision-making.
challenge.paragraph2: EMPOWERALL works to understand and address these barriers, creating better conditions for new generation farmers to take an active role in agroecological transitions.

approach.title: From knowledge to action, together.
approach.intro: EMPOWERALL combines scientific and local knowledge with systems and futures thinking to understand complex challenges, explore possible futures and co-create practical pathways for change.

listen.title: Listen
listen.body: Understand local challenges, experiences and needs, bringing together different perspectives to identify the barriers, opportunities and priorities that shape each territory.

connect.title: Connect
connect.body: Bring farmers, researchers, advisors, communities and policymakers together, combining scientific, local and practical knowledge to build a shared understanding of each context.

explore.title: Explore
explore.body: Use systems thinking and futures thinking to understand how different factors interact, imagine possible futures and identify pathways towards more sustainable agrifood systems.

cocreate.title: Co-create
cocreate.body: Develop and test agroecological practices, governance models and other locally relevant innovations through transdisciplinary action research.

learn.title: Learn & scale
learn.body: Connect local experience with long-term observation, build evidence and turn project learning into knowledge and solutions that can be adapted and shared across territories.

inform.title: Inform
inform.body: Translate project evidence and learning into policy recommendations that can support agroecological transitions, including at European level.

livingLabs.title: Four places with a long memory.
livingLabs.intro: EMPOWERALL develops four Agroecology Living Labs (AELL) in Spain, France, Romania and Slovakia. Each Living Lab is embedded within a Long-Term Socio-Ecological Research (LTSER) Platform of eLTER RI, connecting local experimentation with established research, monitoring and knowledge of each territory.
livingLabs.research: The Living Labs bring new generation farmers, researchers, advisors, communities and other local actors together to understand challenges, explore possible futures and co-create agroecological solutions. The LTSER Platforms provide long-term socio-ecological observation, transdisciplinarity and networks of local actors needed to follow change, understand context and build stronger evidence over time.
livingLabs.advisoryCouncil: At the core of each AELL, an Advisory Council gives new generation farmers a formal voice in its governance.
livingLabs.tagline: Four AELLs. Four LTSER Platforms. One connected learning network.
livingLabs.mapLabel: Dotted map of Europe highlighting the Living Labs in Romania, Slovakia, France and Spain.

people.title: Built with people, not just for them.

partners.intro: EMPOWERALL brings together partners with expertise in agroecology, farming systems, research, long-term observation, policy, participatory research and stakeholder engagement.
